description: Say a page draft is live: the SEO room’s Mark published. Name it by draft_id (from cvl_seo_drafts or cvl_seo_draft); url is where it went live, on this site’s own domain (omit to keep the address it has, or its page’s). The draft leaves the Drafts count. A draft for a page that already exists closes its SEO to-do and its brief now; a draft for a new page closes them once a crawl finds the page live with the draft’s title and H1 (a finished crawl also publishes such a draft by itself, published_via crawl). Idempotent: the same call again changes nothing (changed: false). A draft this site does not hold is refused with code not_found.

fields.description: Top-level keys to keep, e.g. ["kpis"]: envelope keys, not metric names.

url.description: Where the page went live: a full address on this site’s own domain.
